title: Verify agentic-kit builder agent loads as a plugin agent
description: The agentic-kit plugin was installed mid-session on 2026-10-11, so its builder agent wasn't available to the Agent tool yet (plugin agents load at session start). In a new session: confirm the builder appears in the agent list (as 'builder' or 'agentic-kit:builder'), dispatch a trivial scoped brief to it, and confirm it runs on Sonnet and returns the report format. If the namespace differs from what skills/coordinate/SKILL.md says, fix the kit and bump its version.
acceptance_criteria: Builder dispatched via its plugin agent type and returned a well-formed report; kit docs match the real agent type name.

title: clasp project setup, push and deploy; end-to-end phone test
description: Coordinator + human. clasp create/clone bound to a new standalone script, .clasp.json + appsscript.json (webapp: execute as me, access only myself), clasp push, test the dev URL, then [human] create the web-app deployment and add it to the phone home screen. Upload routine.json to the Drive folder.
acceptance_criteria: Deployed URL works on phone and desktop; a session logged on one device appears on the other.

title: Write contracts: JSON schemas, server API, file ownership
description: Coordinator task. Read the Expanded Routine tab (Sheets connector) and design: routine.json schema (with a real sample), session JSON schema + file naming, Drive folder layout, Apps Script server functions callable via google.script.run (names, params, returns, errors), and file ownership for builders. Commit as docs/contracts.md before dispatching any builder.
acceptance_criteria: docs/contracts.md committed with schemas, a real routine sample, API signatures and an ownership table.
close_reason: docs/contracts.md committed in ae18de2: routine/session schemas, Drive layout, server API, pure-function list, UI behaviour, ownership table. Sheet snapshot at data/expanded-routine.csv.

title: [human] Install clasp, log in, enable Apps Script API
description: One-time per Google account/machine: npm i -g @google/clasp; clasp login (browser OAuth); enable the Apps Script API at https://script.google.com/home/usersettings. Agents cannot do this.
acceptance_criteria: clasp login --status shows logged in; Apps Script API toggle is On.

title: Workout tracker v1 (Apps Script web app)
description: Mobile-friendly workout tracker: Apps Script web app serving a page that reads routine.json and reads/writes per-session history JSON in a Drive folder. Also the first trial of the coordinator/builder workflow from agentic-kit. See AGENTS.md > Project.
acceptance_criteria: On the phone, the home-screen web app shows the routine, logs a workout, and a second device sees that session in history.

title: Mobile UI: routine view + workout logging page
description: Builder task. index.html (HtmlService template plus inline CSS/JS) that shows the routine for today, lets the user log sets/reps/weight per exercise, saves via google.script.run per the contract, and shows the previous session's values for comparison. Mobile-first, works at 360px width. Uses a mock google.script.run for local testing in a browser.
acceptance_criteria: Renders the sample routine.json locally with the mock; logging flow produces a session object that matches the contract schema; no horizontal scroll at 360px.
close_reason: Merged. Verified: reran tests (12/12; suite 31/31). Coordinator browser QA via headless Chrome/CDP at 360px: 18/18 checks (no h-scroll in workout/history, 44px targets, default-day rule, last-time values, rest timer, draft mirror+clear, finish saves a §2-valid session with only touched exercises, history detail, Retry on load failure, dark scheme, no page exceptions).

title: Apps Script backend: Drive JSON read/write
description: Builder task. Code.gs (or src/*.js) implementing the contract's server API: find or create the Drive data folder, read routine.json, save one session file, list/read session history, serve index.html via doGet. Keep pure logic (validation, naming, merging) in functions that are unit-testable with Node.
acceptance_criteria: All contract API functions implemented; Node unit tests for the pure logic pass; no use of APIs outside DriveApp/HtmlService/ContentService without the coordinator's approval.
close_reason: Merged 48775e3. Verified: reran tests (9/9), node --check OK, read Code.js/Lib.js against contract §2-4. Drive I/O untested until deploy (fw-o2k.6).

title: Export Expanded Routine to routine.json
description: Builder task. Convert the Expanded Routine tab into routine.json that matches the contract. The coordinator supplies the sheet data (CSV) in the brief, because builders have no Sheets access. Include a Node validation script checking the file against the schema.
acceptance_criteria: routine.json validates against the contract schema; every exercise row in the sheet is represented.
close_reason: Merged c2fc99b. Verified: reran tests (7/7), 38 unique ids, consistent keys, data quirks preserved, deterministic re-run; slug rule cross-checked against Lib in test/integration.test.js.

title: getAppData reads every session file; read newest-first and stop early
description: readAllSessions_ parses every file in sessions/ on each page load. At ~200 sessions (about a year) this could take 10-20 s in Apps Script. Session file names sort by time (contracts §3), so getAppData can list names, sort descending, and parse only until it has 20 recent summaries and a completed session for every day.
acceptance_criteria: getAppData parses at most ~20 + (days without a recent completed session) files; existing tests still pass.
